sentences.en: And my question is what do you miss about your home country?
sentences.cn: 我的问题是：你最想念自己国家的什么？

sentences.en: So currently I am living in Thailand.
I've been living here for the past six years now, six, seven years.
sentences.cn: 已经在这儿住了 6 年，6、7 年了。

sentences.en: And yeah, I love it here, but there's definitely things I miss about England, first of all, my friends and my family, of course.
sentences.cn: 我很喜欢这里，但肯定有些东西是我在英国会想念的。

sentences.en: I think that is the main thing, especially when it comes to Christmas, birthdays, any type of holiday, New Year, anything.
sentences.cn: 首先当然是我的朋友和家人，我觉得这是最主要的，尤其是到了圣诞节、生日、各种节日

sentences.en: I really start to miss home.
sentences.cn: 新年什么的，我就特别想家。

sentences.en: And I even miss the cold weather and the snow when it gets to Christmas time, which I'd never thought I'd say about England.
sentences.cn: 到了圣诞节前后，我甚至连寒冷的天气和雪都想念，这话我以前从没想过自己会说。

sentences.en: But yeah, I think it's a lot more festive at home during holidays and especially when you're surrounded by your loved ones.
sentences.cn: 不过我觉得，过节的时候家里更有节日气氛，尤其是身边都是你爱的人。

sentences.en: So yeah, definitely the biggest thing I miss at home is friends, family, and sharing the holidays together.
sentences.cn: 所以没错，我最想念的还是朋友、家人，还有一起过节的那种感觉。
